title: Construction and linear calculus of the proper-support subsheaf
statement: For a separated locally finite type f:X->Y and a sheaf F of Lambda-modules [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], the sections of F(X_V) with proper support over V [def-cbc-etale-section-proper-support] are closed under zero, addition and scalar multiplication, restriction, and linear sheaf maps. Membership is local for covering sieves. Their closed support is equivalently tested at all separably closed geometric points [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. The literal submodules of these sections form a sheaf, functorial in F, with a natural sectionwise injective inclusion into f_*F [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] whose image is precisely the proper-support sections. For proper f this inclusion is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Closedness and the equivalence of geometric support tests follow from the module closed-support theorem.

The zero section has empty support. A sum is supported in the union of the summands supports, and scalar multiplication and linear sheaf maps shrink support. Use properness of closed subsets and finite unions.

Restriction and local saturation are the two clauses of the section-locality theorem. The generic subfunctor sheaf criterion now proves that the explicit submodule-valued presheaf is a sheaf. Maps of sheaves restrict to those submodules, giving the functor and its natural inclusion.

The inclusion is literally the subtype linear map, so it is injective with the prescribed image. For proper f, the projection X_V->V is proper and every closed support is proper, hence this inclusion is also surjective.

theorem properSupportSectionCalculus (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] :
    (∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (V : Y.Etale),
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) 0 ∧
      (∀ s t, SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) s →
        SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) t →
        SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) (s + t)) ∧
      (∀ (r : Λ) s,
        SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) s →
        SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) (r • s))) ∧
    (∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (V W : Y.Etale) (h : W ⟶ V) s,
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) s →
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj W) (pullback.fst W.hom f)
        (F.obj.map (f.Etale.map h).op s)) ∧
    (∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (V : Y.Etale) s (S : Sieve V), S ∈ Y.smallEtaleTopology V →
      (∀ (W : Y.Etale) (h : W ⟶ V), S h →
        SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj W) (pullback.fst W.hom f)
          (F.obj.map (f.Etale.map h).op s)) →
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) s) ∧
    (∀ (F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (φ : F ⟶ G) (V : Y.Etale) s,
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) s →
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ G (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f)
        (φ.hom.app (op (f.Etale.obj V)) s)) ∧
    (∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (V : Y.Etale) s,
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) s ↔
        ∃ T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds (f.Etale.obj V).left,
          (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
            (v : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ (f.Etale.obj V).left),
            v default ∈ T ↔
              (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (v ≫ (f.Etale.obj V).hom)).toPresheafFiber
                (f.Etale.obj V) (Over.homMk v) F.obj s ≠ 0) ∧
          IsProper ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal T).subschemeι ≫
            pullback.fst V.hom f)) ∧
    (∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (V : Y.Etale) s,
      ∃ T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds (f.Etale.obj V).left,
        (T : Set (f.Etale.obj V).left) =
          {x | ∃ (Ω : Type u) (_ : Field Ω) (_ : IsAlgClosed Ω)
            (v : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ (f.Etale.obj V).left), v default = x ∧
              (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (v ≫ (f.Etale.obj V).hom)).toPresheafFiber
                (f.Etale.obj V) (Over.homMk v) F.obj s ≠ 0})
